name: Find a case on the case list and open its replay
description: Validates the case list: it is reached from the home page, shows every case with its sketch and how its track is known, and opens the replay.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the home page and click the "All cases" link (data-testid all-cases-link) beside "Case replays"
Assert the URL path is /cases, the page heading reads "Cases", and the list (data-testid case-list) holds the cards case-card-eagle-s-2024 and case-card-yi-peng-3-2024, each with a map image
Assert the Yi Peng 3 card shows "Reconstructed, then AIS from 06:01 UTC" and the Eagle S card shows "Reconstructed from statements"
Click the Yi Peng 3 card (data-testid case-card-yi-peng-3-2024)
Assert the URL path is /cases/yi-peng-3-2024 and the page heading reads "Yi Peng 3 anchor drag"
